dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver/baseimage-alpine:3.22

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG PAIRDROP_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thespad"

# environment settings
ENV NODE_ENV="production"

RUN \
  echo "**** install runtime packages ****" && \
  apk add --no-cache \
    nodejs \
    npm && \
  echo "**** install pairdrop ****" && \
  mkdir -p /app/pairdrop && \
  if [ -z ${PAIRDROP_RELEASE} ]; then \
    PAIRDROP_RELEASE=$(curl -sL "https://api.github.com/repos/schlagmichdoch/pairdrop/tags" \
    | jq -r '.[0].name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/pairdrop.tar.gz -L \
    "https://github.com/schlagmichdoch/PairDrop/archive/refs/tags/${PAIRDROP_RELEASE}.tar.gz" && \
  tar xf \
    /tmp/pairdrop.tar.gz -C \
    /app/pairdrop/ --strip-components=1 && \
  cd /app/pairdrop && \
  chown -R abc:abc ./ && \
  su -s /bin/sh abc -c 'HOME=/tmp NODE_ENV=production npm ci' && \
  printf "Linuxserver.io version: ${VERSION}\nBuild-date: ${BUILD_DATE}" > /build_version && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  rm -rf \
    $HOME/.cache \
    /tmp/* \
    /tmp/.npm

# copy local files
COPY root/ /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3000

units.name: init-pairdrop-config
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    lsiown -R abc:abc \
        /config
fi

units.name: svc-pairdrop
units.script:
#!/usr/bin/with-contenv bash
# shellcheck shell=bash

if [[ ${RATE_LIMIT,,} = "true" ]]; then
    OPT_RATE_LIMIT="--rate-limit"
fi

if [[ ${WS_FALLBACK,,} = "true" ]]; then
    OPT_WS_FALLBACK="--include-ws-fallback"
fi

if [[ -z ${LSIO_NON_ROOT_USER} ]]; then
    HOME=/config exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 3000" \
        cd /app/pairdrop s6-setuidgid abc npm start -- "${OPT_RATE_LIMIT}" "${OPT_WS_FALLBACK}"
else
    HOME=/config exec \
        s6-notifyoncheck -d -n 300 -w 1000 -c "nc -z localhost 3000" \
        cd /app/pairdrop npm start -- "${OPT_RATE_LIMIT}" "${OPT_WS_FALLBACK}"
fi
